Modifications: [describe actual changes].

processing: Original continuous exterior, triangles and UVs retained; no subdivision, simplification, concavity deepening, surface displacement, tissue layer, root graft or closure rim.
Original authored normals retained and transformed into presentation axes; tangents re-orthogonalized for numeric precision.
Crown oriented +Y; native arbitrary units scaled to illustrative21mm total height, positions stored in metres.
Native source normal map downsampled, renormalized and UV-island padded at2K/1K.
Native painted colors inform an approximate cervical contour and subtle tone variation, not the final tooth palette.
Deterministic local cosine-hemisphere visibility rays on the original exterior; no cores or artificial occluders.
One material, one primitive, embedded normal plus RGBA parameter map. No original vertex color or base-color texture multiplier.

parameters.R: Enamel mask0root→1crown; inferred CEJ transition−0.10…+0.10mm geodesic distance.
parameters.G: Absolute roughness: enamel~0.265–0.315, root~0.49. Set material.roughness=1 before multiplication.
parameters.B: Source-derived local tone variation centered0.5. Suggested signed value=(B−0.5)*2 and color amplitude~0.02.
parameters.A: Local ambient visibility;40deterministic cosine hemisphere rays/vertex,0.65mm maximum distance,2µm surface offset,remap0.4+0.6visibility.

limitations: CT-informed ZBrush educational reconstruction, not a raw microCT surface.
Source crown has broad smoothed fissures and limited secondary anatomy; preserving it avoids procedural jagged grooves but does not recover missing scan detail.
Cervical mask, material roughness and color variation are visual approximations, not measured tissue or optical data.
Single outer surface optical model; no true dentin/enamel segmented volumes or physically complete subsurface transport.
Nominal21mm scale is illustrative, not an original specimen measurement.

material_export.web_scattering_note: The web viewer adds a restrained 6.5 percent direct-light wrapped-diffuse approximation; this is not transmitted light or volumetric subsurface scattering.
